stage:
CREATE TEMP TABLE IF NOT EXISTS checkout(lot TEXT,name TEXT,unit TEXT,qty REAL CHECK(qty>0 AND qty<=1000000),baseQty REAL NOT NULL CHECK(baseQty>0),price REAL CHECK(price>=0 AND price<=100000000),listPrice REAL,amount INTEGER,stock REAL);
DELETE FROM checkout;
lines: INSERT INTO checkout SELECT s.id,s.name,CASE j.value->>'$.mode' WHEN 'pack' THEN s.unit WHEN 'g' THEN 'г' ELSE s.contentUnit END,j.value->>'$.qty',(j.value->>'$.qty')*(CASE WHEN j.value->>'$.mode'='pack' THEN 1.0 WHEN j.value->>'$.mode'='content' AND s.contentUnit IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0/s.factor WHEN j.value->>'$.mode'='g' AND s.unit='кг' THEN 0.001 END),j.value->>'$.price',s.price*(CASE WHEN j.value->>'$.mode'='pack' THEN 1.0 WHEN j.value->>'$.mode'='content' AND s.contentUnit IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0/s.factor WHEN j.value->>'$.mode'='g' AND s.unit='кг' THEN 0.001 END),round((j.value->>'$.qty')*(j.value->>'$.price')*100),s.stock FROM json_each(@lines) j JOIN sale_stock s ON s.id=j.value->>'$.id' AND s.warehouse=@warehouse WHERE json_type(j.value,'$.qty') IN ('real','integer') AND json_type(j.value,'$.price') IN ('real','integer')
valid: SELECT count(*)=json_array_length(@lines) AND count(*) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT lot FROM checkout GROUP BY lot HAVING round(sum(baseQty)-min(stock),9)>0) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkout WHERE unit IN ('шт','уп') AND qty!=cast(qty AS INTEGER)) AS ok FROM checkout
post: INSERT INTO sales SELECT @id,strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'),@warehouse,@account,@client,(SELECT name FROM warehouses WHERE id=@warehouse),(SELECT name FROM accounts WHERE id=@account),(SELECT name FROM clients WHERE id=@client),@seller,@role,@discount,@tender,sum(amount)-@discount,min(@tender,sum(amount)-@discount) FROM checkout
copy: INSERT INTO sale_lines SELECT @id,lot,name,unit,qty,baseQty,price,listPrice,amount FROM checkout
credit: UPDATE accounts SET amount=round(amount+(SELECT paid/100.0 FROM sales WHERE id=@id),2),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=@account
stock: SELECT * FROM sale_stock ORDER BY name
move:
INSERT INTO stock_movements(id,lot,source,target,qty,name,price,created)
SELECT @id,id,warehouse,@target,@qty,name,price/factor,CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 FROM sale_stock
WHERE id=@lot AND typeof(@qty) IN ('integer','real') AND abs(@qty) BETWEEN 0.000001 AND 1000000
AND (@target IS NULL AND stock+@qty>=0 OR @target IS NOT NULL AND @target!=warehouse AND @qty>0 AND stock>=@qty)
AND (unit NOT IN ('шт','уп') OR abs(@qty*factor-round(@qty*factor))<0.0000001 OR contentUnit NOT IN ('шт','уп') AND contentUnit IS NOT NULL)
history:
SELECT 'sale:'||l.rowid id,'Продажа' operation,CAST(strftime('%s',s.date) AS INTEGER)*1000 postedAt,s.warehouse warehouseId,s.warehouseName,l.name productName,-l.qty quantity,l.unit,l.amount/100.0 total FROM sale_lines l JOIN sales s ON s.id=l.sale
UNION ALL SELECT m.id,CASE WHEN target IS NULL THEN 'Корректировка' ELSE 'Перемещение · расход' END,created,source,w.name,m.name,CASE WHEN target IS NULL THEN qty ELSE -qty END,json_extract(lot,'$[2]'),NULL FROM stock_movements m JOIN warehouses w ON w.id=m.source
UNION ALL SELECT m.id||':in','Перемещение · приход',created,target,w.name,m.name,qty,json_extract(lot,'$[2]'),NULL FROM stock_movements m JOIN warehouses w ON w.id=m.target
